official_split_policy: Preserve set and validation fields exactly; never resplit or filter rows.
secondary_metrics: exact-sequence group macro errors and group-mean Spearman
selection: Maximum full validation Spearman; first registered alpha on exact tie; no train+validation refit.
features: Sequence length + twenty canonical amino-acid fractions + explicit other-residue fraction (including U). No sequence truncation.
model_fit: Float64 closed-form ridge; train-only feature population mean/std; unpenalized train target-mean intercept; no target standardization.
mean_baseline: TRAIN target mean; constant Spearman is undefined and serialized null.
test_policy: Integrity audit may check finite labels; no test metric before frozen configuration and frozen train/validation-selected model.
replication: Deterministic CPU baselines require one exact run; connector experiments will require real paired multi-seed comparisons.
interpretation: Experimental melting phenotype may reflect cell and complex environment; it is not a thermodynamic free-energy gold standard.
